img.caption: Fig 5: OOS-gate sensitivity on CLINC150 (P0-1). Tightening the OOS FPR threshold from 0.05 to 0.0005 raises Macro-F1 from 0.899 to 0.929 while keeping OOS refusal at 100% and reducing false-rejection from 13.9% to 9.7%, showing the F1 gap to few-shot baselines comes from the conservative refusal threshold rather than method quality.
